Implement echo and bye exit command
Add mark and unmark commands with Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Task class to track description and done status, and update

commitResults.messageTitle: Add exception classes, and error handling from erroneous user input
Add save feature and error handling for it
Add dates and times to the command
Extract Ui, Storage, Parser, and TaskList from Axiom
commitResults.messageBody:
Separate concerns so Axiom acts as a thin orchestrator rather than
handling user I/O, command parsing, task-list management, and file
persistence in one class.

- Add Ui for all user-facing input and output (banner, messages, errors)
- Add Parser to interpret commands and build Task objects from user input
- Add TaskList to encapsulate add/delete/mark operations on the task list
- Refactor Storage from static helpers to an instance class that takes a
  file path and saves/loads via TaskList
- Slim Axiom down to constructor + run(), delegating to the new classes
  while preserving existing behaviour (all 21 UI tests still pass)

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Move all Java sources from the default package into a proper package
hierarchy under src/main/java, keeping that folder as the source root.

Package layout:
- axiom: Axiom entry point and AxiomException
- axiom.command: Command enum
- axiom.parser: Parser and DateTimeParser
- axiom.storage: Storage
- axiom.task: Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, TaskList
- axiom.ui: Ui

Add getters on Task subclasses so Storage can serialize tasks across
package boundaries without relying on protected fields. Update the test
run command and README to use src/main/java/axiom/Axiom.java.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Agents need a single reference for SE-EDU Java conventions when editing
this codebase.

Let's add a project skill summarising naming, layout, import, and Javadoc
rules from the SE-EDU basic + intermediate guide.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Commit messages and branch names should follow SE-EDU Git conventions
consistently across this project.

Let's add a project skill covering subject/body format and branch naming
from the SE-EDU Git guide.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate SE-EDU coding skills in AGENTS.md
commitResults.messageBody:
Agent instructions did not point to the new Java and Git standard skills.

Let's require agents to follow seedu-java-coding-standard for Java work
and seedu-git-standard for commits.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Existing Javadoc did not always follow SE-EDU phrasing for class and
method header comments.

Let's update summaries to use noun phrases for classes and verb-led
sentences (Returns, Runs, Processes) for methods. No behavior changes.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot locate tasks in a long list without scanning every entry
manually.

Let's add a find command that matches keywords case-insensitively against
task descriptions and displays results with their original list numbers.
Includes JUnit and UI test coverage.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add assertions for programmer assumptions Parser already rejects invalid user input with AxiomException, but internal callers can still pass null values or out-of-range indices. Those cases are bugs in our code, not user errors. Let's document those invariants with Java assert and enable -ea in Gradle test and run so they are checked during development. Assertions stay disabled in the fat JAR unless the user passes -ea, which is the usual Java default.

commitResults.messageBody: Add assertions for programmer assumptions

The welcome test checks for a 60-character underline that Ui never
prints, so the suite fails even when the greeting is correct.

Let's drop that magic-string check and keep the shorter separator
assertion that actually appears in the banner.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Command.matches to remove duplicated checks
commitResults.messageBody:
fromInput and getArgument both encoded "keyword, or keyword plus a
space" by hand, and getArgument used a magic +1 to skip that space.

Let's give Command a matches() helper and trim after the keyword so
the matching rule lives in one place.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace Parser magic delimiters with named constants
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event parsing sliced the input with hardcoded "/by",
"/from", "/to" strings and matching substring offsets of 5 and 7.

Those numbers hide the delimiter length, so a typo in either place
would silently parse the wrong field.

Let's name the delimiters and reuse them for both search and slicing,
and keep the repeated usage text in one constant per command.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Name the event /from and /to marker checks
commitResults.messageBody:
parseEvent combined three boolean tests in one condition, which makes
it hard to see whether a failure is a missing marker or reversed order.

Let's compute hasFromAndTo and isFromBeforeTo first so the guard reads
as the actual requirement.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Todo, deadline, event, find, and task-number parsing each repeated the
same empty-string check and exception throw.

Let's share that guard so missing-field handling stays consistent and
the happy path in each parse method is easier to see.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace Storage magic format literals with constants
commitResults.messageBody:
Load and save used raw "T", "D", "E", "0", "1", pipe separators, and
substring offset 4 for event times.

Those values are the on-disk schema, so a mismatch between parse and
format would corrupt the save file.

Let's name every field, type code, and delimiter and reuse them in
both directions.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Use the real file path in Storage parse errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Corrupt-line messages always said data/axiom.txt even when Storage was
constructed with a different path, which can send the reader looking in
the wrong file.

Let's include filePath so the error describes the file that was actually
read.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract stored deadline and event parsing helpers
commitResults.messageBody:
createTask mixed type dispatch with field-level deadline and event
parsing, so one method sat at two abstraction levels.

Let's keep createTask as a switch over type codes and move each type's
details into helpers named for that job.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Serialize tasks with a switch and a default branch
commitResults.messageBody:
formatTask used a chain of instanceof checks and treated the final
throw as an afterthought, so an unexpected type was not an explicit
default case.

Let's switch on the task type, share the field-joining logic, and keep
the unknown-type error in default as the catch-all.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

After the GUI refactor, Axiom prints format*() results directly, so
showGoodbye, showTaskList, and the other println wrappers were never
called.

Let's delete that dead code so Ui only keeps methods that still have
callers.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Reuse formatted welcome text in the CLI greeting
commitResults.messageBody:
showWelcome duplicated the banner, hello, and prompt strings already
built by formatGuiWelcome, so a wording change could make CLI and GUI
greetings drift apart.

Let's print the same formatted text in both places.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

formatTaskList and formatMatchingTasks both built " n.task" lines by
hand, so a list-layout change would need two edits.

Let's append those lines through one helper.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

tmp, db, and ap do not say what they hold, so a reader has to track
the assignment to learn the type.

Let's use children, dialogBox, and anchorPane instead.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace GUI layout magic numbers with named constants
commitResults.messageBody:
Dialog width, font size, window minimums, and the exit delay appeared
as raw literals, so a reader cannot tell why those values were chosen.

Let's name them so the layout constraints are documented in the code.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Name the done and not-done status icons
commitResults.messageBody:
getStatusIcon returned "X" or a single space, which looks like
placeholder text unless the reader already knows the display format.

Let's give those literals names so the status column is obvious.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Name the start-of-day check in DateTimeParser
commitResults.messageBody:
format() used hour == 0 && minute == 0 to decide between date-only and
date-time output, which hides that midnight means "date with no time".

Let's extract isAtStartOfDay() so the branch reads as that rule.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Share the default save-file path in one constant
commitResults.messageBody:
CLI and GUI each hardcoded data/axiom.txt, so changing the default
location would require two matching edits.

Let's keep the path on Axiom and have Main use that constant.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Narrow task field visibility to the owning class
commitResults.messageBody:
description, isDone, by, from, and to were protected even though no
subclass reads those fields directly, which widens access more than
needed.

Let's make them private, and final where they never change, so each
value is only mutated through the class's own methods.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

parseStored called input.trim() in both the success path and the
error message, which repeats the same cleanup.

Let's trim once into a local variable and reuse it.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Use Java Streams for collection processing Task search, command matching, file serialization, and list formatting currently use explicit for-loops over collections. Streams express those filter-map-collect pipelines more directly and keep the behavior the same. Let's rewrite findMatchingTaskNumbers, Command.fromInput, Storage.save, and the Ui list formatters to use Stream APIs. Loops that throw checked exceptions or try parsers in sequence are left unchanged, because wrapping them in streams would hide the control flow.

commitResults.messageBody:
The description is assigned in the constructor and never updated, so
leaving it mutable suggests callers might change the text later.

Let's mark it final so the field can only be set once.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Todo, Deadline, and Event each inlined [T], [D], or [E] in toString,
so those tags look like punctuation rather than a display format.

Let's give each prefix a name so the type column is obvious.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

formatGuiWelcome is also used for the CLI greeting, so the Gui in the
name implies a GUI-only helper and trips up readers of showWelcome.

Let's call it formatWelcome to match both callers.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Axiom.run printed execute() results with System.out.println while
welcome, errors, and separator lines already go through Ui, so CLI
output is split across two places.

Let's add showMessage and use it for replies so all console I/O stays
in Ui.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Hide the task list's backing collection
commitResults.messageBody:
getTasks() returned the live ArrayList, so callers could add or remove
tasks without going through TaskList, and the constructor aliased the
list passed in from Storage.

Let's copy loaded tasks, iterate through TaskList itself, and keep the
internal list private.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

findMatchingTaskNumbers returned 1-based numbers while get, delete,
and mark all use 0-based indexes, so readers have to remember two
numbering schemes in the same class.

Let's return 0-based indexes and convert to user-facing numbers only
when Ui prints the match list.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

markAsDone and markAsNotDone are the same operation with opposite
outcomes, but findMatchingIndexes sat between them, so related
mutations were not consecutive in the class.

Let's keep the two mark methods adjacent so the status API reads as
one unit.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Name the user-number to index conversion
commitResults.messageBody:
mark, unmark, and delete each subtracted 1 from the parsed task
number, which hides that user-facing numbers are one-based while the
list is zero-based.

Let's convert through toZeroBasedIndex so that shift has one name and
one place.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

formatTaskAdded and formatDeleted both built "Now you have N tasks in
the list", so a wording change would need two matching edits.

Let's format that count through one helper.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Lift date parsing to one level of abstraction
commitResults.messageBody:
parse() mixed trying each formatter with deciding among date-time,
date-only, and invalid input, so the happy path was buried in nested
try/catch loops.

Let's try each kind of format in a helper so parse() reads as
date-time, then date, then error.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Share the indented task confirmation line
commitResults.messageBody:
Add, mark, unmark, and delete replies each inlined a three-space
indent plus the task, so the confirmation layout was copied four
times.

Let's format that task line in one helper with a named indent.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep GUI input handling at one abstraction level
commitResults.messageBody:
handleUserInput both updated the chat transcript and wired the
shutdown timer, so the main path mixed reply display with JavaFX
exit details.

Let's move the delayed close into exitAfterDelay so this method only
orchestrates one user turn.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Return the specific task type from parsers
commitResults.messageBody:
parseTodo, parseDeadline, and parseEvent all declared Task even though
each always builds one subclass, so callers could not see the real
type without a cast or instanceof check.

Let's return Todo, Deadline, and Event directly.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
